notes: V30.30 makes the Deep survey clock the live photo-puzzle clock. Every posed Deep request freezes the exact RGB, Alva pose, intrinsics and 2-D features into one frame node; the asynchronous relative depth can only return to that node. RGB overlap creates a live photo graph, geometric correspondences plus Alva triangulation estimate per-frame Deep scale, and PHOTO/DEPTH atlases use pose-aware reprojection with z-buffer/best-view compositing instead of blur-producing image averaging.
